<b>Voltvyrm</b> is a [[Bosses (Silksong)|boss]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It is a nest of coiled worms found in the recesses of the [[Voltnest]] capable of controlling electricity to attack intruders.<ref name=hj/> Defeating it grants the [[Volt Filament]].

== Background ==
Voltvyrm is a nest of charged worms which resides in Voltnest. It attacks anyone who intrudes on its home with electricity.<ref name=hj>Voltvyrm [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Coiled nest of charged worms. Assaults intruders with bolts of crackling electricity."</i></ref> It is completely unaffected by the [[Haunting]], but possesses only basic thought.<ref>[[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Barely a bug, and possessing only basic thought, yet instinct alone proved enough to turn it deadly."</i></ref>

[[The Citadel]] [[The Choir|choir]] bugs kept Voltvyrms and [[Voltridian]] in the northern section of the [[Memorium]]. The [[Memoria|Memoriae]] studied and experimented with Voltvyrms, using their research to create [[Voltvessels]], the effects of which greatly resemble the Voltridian-boosted attacks of Voltvyrms.

== In-game Events ==
Voltvyrm is encountered at the end of [[Voltnest]]. Upon defeat, the [[Volt Filament]] floats down out of its shell.

[[Nuu]] appears in its arena later on, inspecting the Voltvyrm's corpse.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
{{AttackDisclaimer}}

The Voltvyrm resides in a ceiling mass of barnacles, switching randomly between 3 holes (left, right, or centre) to emerge from. When it emerges from a hole, it performs an electric attack before retreating and repeating the process. It has the following two attacks:
* <b>Volt Pillars</b>: Voltvyrm creates waves of electric columns that span the arena vertically in the following patterns:
** 3 waves of paired columns which start from the edges of the arena and close in, ending with the 2 middle columns.
** 3 waves of paired columns which start from the middle and expand outwards to the edges of the arena.
** 4 waves consisting of 2 columns at the edges, then the 2 middle columns one after the other, and finally ending with the 2 columns between the edges and the centre.
* <b>Volt Field</b>: Voltvyrm creates a burst of small electric circles across the arena in the following patterns:
** 6 circles in a line, with each alternating the top and bottom halves of the arena, creating a zigzag pattern.
** 6–7 paired up circles in a line, with each pair alternating the top and bottom halves of the arena, creating a looser zigzag.
** 6 circles stacked in pairs to create 3 spaced-apart columns.
** 7 circles that cover the entire ground of the arena, forcing [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to be airborne.
All electric attacks are first telegraphed by the area of effect being outlined in glowing pink light, before then creating a lingering zone of damage.

If Hornet jumps into the mass of Barnacles on the ceiling, she takes electric damage. All electric damage, including Voltvyrm's attacks, deal {{Damage|1+1}}. Contact with Voltvyrm only deals {{Damage|1}}.

== Location ==
Voltvyrm is found at the end of [[Voltnest]] in the northern part of [[Sands of Karak]].
